projectors.before: For a unitary fusion category and any fixed adjacent pair of simple site charges, the family $(P_{i,s})_s$ from [[def-anyonic-local-channel-projector]] is pairwise orthogonal, self-adjoint, and idempotent, and its sum over all simple pair outputs $s$ is the identity on the path space.
projectors.after: Let $b,c,a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be simple objects of a unitary fusion category, with $n\ge2$, and let $T_{\mathrm{fixed}}$ be a fixed parenthesization of $b\otimes a_1\otimes\cdots\otimes a_n$. Equip $H=\operatorname{Hom}(c,T_{\mathrm{fixed}})$ with the split Hom inner product $g^\dagger h=\langle h,g\rangle\operatorname{id}_c$ and choose orthonormal split vertex bases in the trees below. Fix $1\le i<n$. Let $A_i:T_{\mathrm{fixed}}\to T_{\mathrm{pair}}$ be a composite of associators and inverses to a tree fusing $a_i,a_{i+1}$ first, without permuting inputs. Let $F_i$ be the matrix of $h\mapsto A_i\circ h$, with target rows and source columns, and let $\Pi_s$ project onto all pair-first coordinates of simple pair output $s$, retaining every multiplicity index. Define $P_{i,s}:=F_i^{-1}\Pi_sF_i$, extending the repeated-charge construction of [[def-anyonic-local-channel-projector]] to these arbitrary simple site charges. Then $(P_{i,s})_s$ is pairwise orthogonal, self-adjoint, and idempotent, and its sum over all simple outputs of $a_i\otimes a_{i+1}$ is the identity on $H$.
